en: Hetuduka, Atītārammaṇattika (The Triplet on Past Objects within the Dyad on Roots)

Dependent on a state that is a root-condition (*hetu*) with a past object, there arises a state that is not a root-condition and does not have a past object, by way of root-condition (*hetupaccaya*). ... [Under] root-condition: three; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance: three.

Dependent on a state that is a root-condition with a future object, there arises a state that is not a root-condition and does not have a future object, by way of root-condition. ... [Under] root-condition: three; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance: three.

Dependent on a state that is a root-condition with a present object, there arises a state that is not a root-condition and does not have a present object, by way of root-condition. ... [Under] root-condition: three; ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance: three.
